records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Applebee’s system-wide domestic same-restaurant sales decreased 4.6% for the three months ended March 31, 2024 as compared to the same period of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total gross profit for the three months ended March 31, 2024 decreased compared with the same period of the prior year, due to decreased revenue from franchise and rental operations and increased franchisor advertising contribution.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in interest expense primarily related to higher-rate securitized notes and borrowings from our revolving line of credit.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, income before income taxes for the three months ended March 31, 2024 decreased compared to the prior year period due to a gain on extinguishment of debt in the same period in the prior year, increased interest expense and increased G&A expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities increased $14.5 million during the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to the same period of the prior year.
